title: Routing Collapse in Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts: Cross-Modal Conditioning Restores Expert Diversity Without Improving Accuracy
abstract: arXiv:2611.28725v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) classifiers are increasingly applied to multimodal emotion recognition, yet the health of their routing distributions is rarely measured. We study a seven-expert MoE head on IEMOCAP under two conditions that differ only in how modality embeddings are fused before reaching it: a learned scalar gate alone, and the same gate preceded by pairwise cross-modal attention. Under scalar fusion the router collapses, concentrating on 1.88 of seven experts at a normalised entropy of 0.241. Cross-modal fusion raises entropy to 0.537 and utilisation to 3.25 experts, a 2.23x increase (p=0.035, Cohen's d=2.55), and induces emotion-differentiated routing absent in the scalar case. This recovered diversity confers no detectable benefit: across six seeds per condition, weighted accuracy (p=0.646) and run-to-run variance (p=0.768) are statistically indistinguishable. translated_title: 多模态混合专家模型中的路由崩溃：跨模态条件化可恢复专家多样性但不提升准确率
translated_abstract: 混合专家分类器正日益应用于多模态情感识别，但其路由分布的健康状况却很少被测量。我们在IEMOCAP数据集上研究了一个七专家的MoE分类头，比较了两种仅在模态嵌入到达该头之前融合方式不同的条件：一种是仅使用可学习的标量门控，另一种是在相同门控之前加入成对跨模态注意力。在标量融合条件下，路由器发生崩溃，负载集中在七个专家中的约1.88个上，归一化熵仅为0.241。跨模态融合将熵提升至0.537，专家利用率提升至3.25个，增长2.23倍（p=0.035，Cohen's d=2.55），并诱导出标量情形下不存在的情感差异化路由。然而这种恢复的多样性并未带来可检测的收益：在每种条件下六个随机种子的实验中，加权准确率（p=0.646）与运行间方差（p=0.768）在统计上无显著差异。我们还观察到在相同配置下存在13个百分点的准确率波动（原文摘要至此截断）。
tldr: 该研究揭示了多模态MoE情感识别模型中的路由崩溃现象——标量门控融合导致路由器仅依赖约1.88个专家，而跨模态注意力融合可将专家利用率提升至3.25个并产生情感差异化路由，但统计检验表明这种专家多样性的恢复并未带来准确率或稳定性的改善。
en_tdlr: In multimodal MoE emotion recognition, scalar-gate fusion causes routing collapse (utilizing only ~1.88 of seven experts), while cross-modal attention fusion restores expert diversity (3.25 experts, 2.23x increase), yet this recovered diversity confers no statistically detectable improvement in accuracy or stability.
